login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the username and password your manager gave you.
login.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.

errors.invalidCredentials: That username or password is not right. Check both and try again.
errors.inactive: This account is not active. Ask your manager to turn it back on.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Sign-in did not work. Try again, or ask your manager.

ended.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
ended.inactive: This account is not active any more. Ask your manager.

mfa.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for this account.
mfa.setupBody: Admin accounts need a second step. Scan the code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.setupLater: This becomes required in Phase 1. You can skip it for now.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
mfa.secretLabel: Or enter this key by hand
mfa.wrongCode: That code did not work. Check the time on your phone and try again.
mfa.setupFailed: Two-step sign-in could not be set up. Try again.

shell.notAvailableTitle: No screens for this role yet
shell.notAvailableBody: Rider screens arrive in Phase 3. Sign out to use another account.
shell.notFoundBody: Go back to your home screen.
shell.errorBody: Reload the app. If it happens again, tell your manager.
shell.updateReady: A new version of the app is ready.
shell.offlineReady: The app is ready to work with a weak connection.

waiter.mineHint: Shows your tables and the free ones.
waiter.otherWaiterToast: Table {{number}} is served by another waiter.
waiter.tablesEmptyBody: An admin adds tables in the admin screens.
waiter.loadFailedBody: Check the connection, then try again.
waiter.totalOnSend: The total is worked out when you send.
waiter.reviewDescription: Change quantities or add notes for the kitchen.
waiter.reviewEmpty: No items yet. Tap a menu item to add it.
waiter.soldOutInCart: Sold out: remove it to send.
waiter.cartHasSoldOut: Remove the sold-out items to send.
waiter.billToast: The cashier has the bill request for table {{number}}
waiter.cancelHint: To cancel an item, ask the cashier.
waiter.moveDescription: Choose a free table. The order and its bill move with it.
waiter.moveNoFree: There are no free tables right now.
waiter.notYoursTitle: Table {{number}} is served by another waiter
waiter.notYoursBody: Ask the cashier to hand it over to you.
waiter.alertsEmptyBody: When the kitchen marks your food Ready, it appears here.
waiter.startShiftBody: Turns on the Ready sound and keeps the screen awake.
waiter.wakeLockOn: The screen stays awake while this app is open.
waiter.wakeLockOff: This phone can't keep the screen awake. Keep the app open.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.queueEmptyBody: New orders appear here as soon as a waiter sends them.

cashier.title: Cashier
cashier.billsEmptyBody: Bills appear here when an order is sent.
cashier.detailEmptyBody: Its lines, totals and payment appear here.

rpcErrors.network: The connection dropped before the server answered. Check the connection, then tap again: nothing is sent twice.
rpcErrors.unknown: That did not work. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your manager.
rpcErrors.NOT_AUTHORIZED: Your account can't do this. Ask the cashier or your manager.
rpcErrors.REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED: The app sent an incomplete request. Reload the app and try again.
rpcErrors.REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: This was already sent with different details. Check the order before sending again.
rpcErrors.SETTINGS_MISSING: The restaurant settings are missing. Tell your manager.
rpcErrors.ORDER_TYPE_REQUIRED: Choose Dine-In or Take Away first.
rpcErrors.ORDER_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED: This kind of order can't be taken here yet.
rpcErrors.TABLE_REQUIRED: Choose a table for a Dine-In order.
rpcErrors.TABLE_NOT_ALLOWED: A Take Away order has no table.
rpcErrors.TABLE_NOT_FOUND: That table is not in use any more. Go back to Tables and choose another.
rpcErrors.TABLE_HAS_OPEN_ORDER: This table already has an open order. Go back to Tables and open it there.
rpcErrors.TABLE_SAME: The order is already on that table.
rpcErrors.CUSTOMER_DETAILS_INVALID: The customer's name or phone is too long. Shorten it and try again.
rpcErrors.WAITER_INVALID: That waiter is not active. Choose another waiter.
rpcErrors.WAITER_NOT_ALLOWED: Only Dine-In orders have a waiter.
rpcErrors.ITEMS_TOO_MANY: That is too many lines for one send. Send part of the order first, then add the rest.
rpcErrors.ITEM_INVALID: One of the items could not be read. Remove it and add it again.
rpcErrors.ITEM_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED: One of the items could not be read. Remove it and add it again.
rpcErrors.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: An item is no longer on the menu. Remove it and try again.
rpcErrors.ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: An item in this order is sold out. Remove it, then send again.
rpcErrors.QUANTITY_INVALID: Each quantity must be between 1 and 99.
rpcErrors.NOTES_INVALID: A note is too long. Keep notes under 200 characters.
rpcErrors.ORDER_NOT_FOUND: This order can't be found any more. Go back and check the table.
rpcErrors.ORDER_CLOSED: This order is already closed. Go back and check the table.
rpcErrors.ORDER_ALREADY_PAID: This bill is already paid. Ask the cashier if something needs to change.
rpcErrors.ORDER_NOT_PAID: The bill is not paid yet. Take the payment first.
rpcErrors.ORDER_STATUS_INVALID: This can't be done at the order's current stage. Check the order and try again.
rpcErrors.ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED: Food that is ready can't be cancelled as a whole order. Cancel single items instead.
rpcErrors.ORDER_NUMBER_NEEDS_DATE: The order number could not be made. Tell your manager.
rpcErrors.BUSINESS_DATE_NEEDS_TIME: The business day could not be worked out. Tell your manager.
rpcErrors.STATUS_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: The order has moved on since you opened it. Check its status and try again.
rpcErrors.KITCHEN_STATUS_USE_BATCHES: Preparing and Ready are set by the kitchen on each batch.
rpcErrors.BATCH_NOT_FOUND: That kitchen ticket can't be found any more.
rpcErrors.BATCH_STATUS_INVALID: A kitchen ticket can only move to Preparing or Ready.
rpcErrors.BATCH_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: That kitchen ticket has moved on. Check its status and try again.
rpcErrors.REASON_TOO_LONG: The reason is too long. Keep it under 300 characters.
rpcErrors.DISCOUNT_INVALID: Enter a discount of zero or more.
rpcErrors.DISCOUNT_TOO_LARGE: The discount can't be more than the bill.
rpcErrors.SUBTOTAL_INVALID: The bill could not be worked out. Tell your manager.
rpcErrors.ROUNDING_UNIT_INVALID: The rounding setting is wrong. Tell your manager.
rpcErrors.ROUNDING_NEEDS_NON_NEGATIVE_VALUE: The bill could not be rounded. Tell your manager.
rpcErrors.NOTHING_TO_PAY: There is nothing left to pay on this bill.
rpcErrors.TENDERS_TOO_MANY: Too many payment parts. Use fewer.
rpcErrors.TENDER_INVALID: One of the payments could not be read. Enter it again.
rpcErrors.TENDER_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED: One of the payments could not be read. Enter it again.
rpcErrors.TENDER_METHOD_INVALID: Choose Cash or Card for each payment.
rpcErrors.TENDER_AMOUNT_INVALID: Each payment must be more than zero.
rpcErrors.TENDERED_INVALID: The cash received must be at least the cash amount.
rpcErrors.REFERENCE_INVALID: The card reference is too long. Keep it to 64 characters.
rpcErrors.PAYMENT_MISMATCH: The payments must add up to the total exactly.
rpcErrors.PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND: That payment can't be found any more.
rpcErrors.PAYMENT_IMMUTABLE: A recorded payment can't be changed. An admin can void it.
rpcErrors.PAYMENT_VOID_ON_INSERT: A new payment can't be voided at once. Record it first.
rpcErrors.PAYMENT_RECEIVER_NOT_ALLOWED: Only the cashier or an admin can take payments.
rpcErrors.VOID_REQUIRES_ADMIN: Only an admin can void a payment.
rpcErrors.MOVE_NOTHING_TO_CHANGE: Choose a new table or a new waiter.
rpcErrors.MOVE_DINE_IN_ONLY: Only Dine-In orders can change table.
rpcErrors.USERNAME_INVALID: That username can't be used. Use 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
rpcErrors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That username is already taken. Choose another.
rpcErrors.PROFILE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This staff account could not be set up. Tell your manager.
